label: Alpine Stat Card
description: Alpine KPI stat card — friendly mobile-marketing card: accent icon + muted label, dominant count-up value, SVG-triangle delta (green up / red down) + sublabel. Light by default; "dark" preset for the night look (the FFmpeg Weekly Pulse hero passes preset:"dark" + its own accent/card).

delta.label: Delta
delta.description: Signed change, pre-formatted (e.g. "+12.4%"). Omit for no delta.

sublabel.label: Sublabel
sublabel.description: Muted caption next to the delta (e.g. "vs last week").

direction.label: Direction
direction.description: Delta direction — arrow + color (green up / red down / muted flat).

icon.label: Icon
icon.description: Named glyph for the accent chip (shared alpine catalog). A derived HUMAN view of the raw iconPath agent prop: picking a name WRITES the SVG path into iconPath (the stored, code-friendly value); a bespoke agent-written path shows as no selection.

renderMode.label: Render Mode
renderMode.description: Reveal quality/cost. "premium" (default): soft alpha crossfade — best look, a per-pixel geq. "light": geq-free (header static, delta band slides). The FFmpeg pulse hero opts into light.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: Accent color (icon chip + up-delta). Defaults to the alpine primary.

backgroundColor.label: Card color
backgroundColor.description: Card surface color. "black@0" → transparent (composed under a chrome).

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Skip motion; render the final static card.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length
anim.introFrac.description: Share of the clip the intro fills (the rest holds).

anim.countUp.label: Count up
anim.countUp.description: Count the value up on intro.

anim.label: Animation
anim.description: Intro reveal: reduceMotion, intro length, easing, count-up.

theme.slug.label: Producer slug
theme.slug.description: Producer template to seed tokens from (e.g. "@m0saic/theming/v1").

theme.namespace.label: Namespace
theme.namespace.description: Upstream alias to read tokens from. Default "theme".

theme.forceFetch.label: Force fetch
theme.forceFetch.description: Re-seed via the slug even if the namespace is populated.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Opt into a theme source. Uses the local palette by default; set a producer slug + namespace to pull shared design tokens. Explicit accent/card color still win.

iconPath.label: Icon path (SVG d)
iconPath.description: Glyph SVG path d (24×24 viewBox), drawn as a mask on the accent chip — the raw value behind the friendly `icon` knob, and the override that wins. Omit both for the bare colored square.

debugGeometry.label: Debug geometry
debugGeometry.description: Dev-only geometry contract view: renders the contract wireframe instead of the card — every element GREEN when its computed rect survived to the pixels at this canvas, realized RED + intended amber ghost when not. Deterministic default false; production never sets it.
